reality_check_2026_08_26.method: Every verdict read from the named file or run read-only against production. The roll-up itself was EXECUTED against the live database rather than reasoned about. Full detail in 01-spec.md section 2.
reality_check_2026_08_26.the_good_news: collabCounts.forBrand already returns the whole campaigns->sets->creators tree with a step and a turn per creator, and it RECONCILES AT EVERY LEVEL on live data. Kanchi Silks: tab 8 = campaigns 5 + creators tab 3; Festive Season 0 own + 3 beneath = 3; Monsoon Cottons 0 + 2 = 2. Stage 3 is overwhelmingly a screen job.
reality_check_2026_08_26.the_brand_throws_it_away: BrandHomeScreen:83 and BrandActionRequiredScreen:65 both call the endpoint carrying the tree. Grep for needs_you across the whole app: ZERO hits. Computed on every call, discarded every time. No tab badge, no campaign badge, no step number anywhere in screens/brand (the only step hit is Stage 2's wizard rail, a different thing).
reality_check_2026_08_26.the_creator_has_two_step_models: The server's six are Agree/Sign/Shoot/Shop posts/Go live/Complete. collabDetailModel.SPINE is Invite/Nego/Sign/Active/Track/Done — the OLD model. AND spineFor matches on stage names Stage 1 renamed: SPINE expects invites/applied/negotiating/to_sign/active/tracking/completed, deriveStage now emits invitations/pitches/to_sign/shoot/content/done. They overlap in EXACTLY ONE value. findIndex returns -1 for everything else, so every node renders 'todo' and NO CURRENT STEP IS HIGHLIGHTED. Same shape as Stage 1 bug #9, live right now.
reality_check_2026_08_26.creator_reads_the_badge_only: InfluencerNavigator:154 calls getNeedsYou and uses `total` for the tab badge. The `collaborations` array — the per-collaboration step — is fetched and discarded.

That comment is now half stale — campaign_influencers.offer_valid_until (migration 148) and brand_offers.store_ends_at both exist. Checked against production: 0 of 6 collaborations and 0 of 1 offers carry one, because nothing writes them and the phone's offer builder cannot set one. So it is computable and honestly zero, which is a different statement.
reality_check_2026_08_26.production_data: 2 campaigns, 3 sets, 6 collaborations at invited/contracted/active/active/active/completed, 1 submitted deliverable, 3 shop posts. Steps 2, 3, 4 and 6 all represented with three different turns — varied enough to walk the whole ladder. BUT not one contract is signed (contract_signed_at and brand_signed_at NULL on all six, including those marked active).

decisions_taken.delete_the_creators_second_spine: Not repair it. Two derivations kept in step forever is the fault this programme has now fixed five times, and this one is already broken. Cost: her spine gains a network dependency — mitigated because the navigator already makes that call for the badge, so the result is shared rather than re-fetched. It must render from cache on failure, never blank.
decisions_taken.missing_owed_items_go_in_collabCounts: Not in the screens. An item counted in a screen is invisible to the roll-up, so the badge above it would be wrong — the one failure the spine exists to prevent.
decisions_taken.brand_spine_lives_in_the_campaigns_stack: The ladder is Campaigns > campaign > set > creator > step. A cross-stack navigate resolves to nothing at runtime while passing every build check — the Stage 1 lesson, and why Stage 2 put all seven wizard screens in one stack.

open_question_for_founder.question: FINAL 4 says the tab-bar badge is the only number spanning both halves. The server already returns it; the brand app shows NO tab badge at all today. Turning it on means a number appears on the brand's tab bar for the first time — against today's data, 8.
open_question_for_founder.recommendation: Turn it on. It is the entry point to everything else in this stage, and a ladder nobody is told to climb gets climbed by nobody. Flagged because it is the one change a brand notices without opening anything.

release.maestro_note: Mobile-governed: this stage adds routes to BOTH apps. Rule 5 applies at release. R-8 requires a Maestro flow over the brand ladder — the gap Stage 2 left open, and the gate on marking EITHER stage released.

release.outward_facing: One visible change without anyone opening anything: a badge appears on the brand's tab bar, reading 8 today. Nothing is new — those eight things have been owed all along and the server has counted them since Stage 0. The change is that the brand is now told.

carried_from_stage_2.punch_list_open: The founder walked Stage 2 and called it almost ok, with UI and cosmetic changes to follow in one batch. Stage 2 is NOT closed.
carried_from_stage_2.not_cosmetic: One Stage 2 item is missing FUNCTION, not polish, and was found while surveying this stage: the phone's offer builder cannot set a minimum basket, a scope, a redemption mode or an expiry. buildDiscount hardcodes scope:'store'. So every offer built on a phone applies to the whole store, and nothing on a phone can give an offer a deadline — which is why the set-level offer-expiry item here will always count zero. Recorded in stage-2's 06-diff/notes.md section 2.3a.
